statements.status_notes: CVE-2026-97058 is reported against sprintf-js 1.1.3 and earlier; the npm registry latest release is still 1.1.3 with no patched version published. sprintf-js is a transitive dependency in the Directus production node_modules tree built into the directus-12 package consumed by this image. DHI will pin a fixed sprintf-js release via the directus package build when upstream publishes one and reassess runtime reachability for the API server deployment.

CVE-2026-97058 is reported against sprintf-js 1.1.3 and earlier; the npm registry latest release is still 1.1.3 with no patched version published. sprintf-js is a transitive dependency in the Directus production node_modules tree built into the directus-12 package consumed by this image. DHI will pin a fixed sprintf-js release via the directus package build when upstream publishes one and reassess runtime reachability for the API server deployment.

CVE-2026-97058 flags sprintf-js 1.0.3 in the Trigger.dev webapp dependency tree. Scout lists affected versions through 1.1.3 with no fixed release on npm yet. Investigating which package pulls sprintf-js 1.0.3 and whether that formatting path is reachable in the self-hosted webapp.

Docker Scout and the npm registry list no release newer than 1.1.3, and the advisory reports no patched version. sprintf-js is a transitive runtime dependency of the Uptime Kuma Node application. Impact and reachability of the improper quantity validation flaw are under assessment until upstream publishes a fix.
